Quick Answers

The most frequent questions — direct answers, no detours.

What is your exact profile?+
Mechatronics engineering student, specialized in autonomous robotics. Dual skill set in software (ROS2, AI) and hardware (mechanics, electronics, automation).
What is your availability?+
Seeking a robotics internship for February / March 2027. Available for interviews now, in French or English.
What is your main tech stack?+
ROS2 + Nav2 + MoveIt for robotics, YOLO + PyTorch for vision, STM32 + TIA Portal for embedded and automation, SolidWorks + ANSYS for design.
What makes you different?+
My ability to learn quickly, work in a team and coordinate. These strengths rest on a versatile, demanding engineering education, plus internships and academic projects that gave me hands-on experience, from design to validation of robotic systems.
Do you speak multiple languages?+
Yes: French (B2), English (B2), Arabic (native). I can work in technical English with no issue.
How can I reach you quickly?+
By email at adim.jebali@eniso.u-sousse.tn or via LinkedIn. I usually reply within 24 hours.
